subject: FY 2026 Preliminary Budget Review
overview: The Committee of the Whole met for its sixth preliminary fiscal year 2026 budget meeting to review the municipal budgets for the Police Department, Department of Public Works, and Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Police Department Budget
items.summary: The Committee reviewed the proposed FY 2026 Police Department budget of $15,177,397, focusing on staffing shortages, recruitment strategies, mental health co-response clinicians, and interactions with federal law enforcement.

items.title: Traffic Commission and Traffic Supervisors Budgets
items.summary: The Committee reviewed the level-funded Traffic Commission budget of $30,500 and the proposed Traffic Supervisors budget of $370,500, which includes a contractual two percent raise.

items.title: Department of Public Works and Engineering Budgets
items.summary: The Committee discussed the DPW and Engineering budgets, focusing on the multi-year plan to remove all lead water pipes by 2032, personnel vacancies, and the increased costs associated with the new ten-year waste disposal and composting contract.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Budget
items.summary: The Committee reviewed the school department's budget request, discussing strategies to close the $2 million variance between the School Committee's voted budget of $87,582,290 and the mayor's proposed allocation of $85,490,000.
